props.gloss_en: 'the army of Persia and Media, the nobles' (Esth 1:3) -- with the nobles, Persia is named first
and it is written: 'of the kings of Media and Persia' (Esth 10:2) -- with the kings, Media is named first
Rava: they stipulated with each other: if the kings are from us, the ministers are from you; and if the kings are from you, the ministers are from us
R' Yosei bar Chanina: 'when he showed the riches of his glorious kingdom' (Esth 1:4) teaches that he wore the priestly vestments
one said: he was a clever king
and one said: he was a foolish king
for the one who says clever: he did well to bring the distant ones close first, for the people of his own town he can appease whenever he wishes
for the one who says foolish: he should have brought the people of his town close first, so that if those rebelled against him, these would have stood with him
the students: [that generation was liable to annihilation] because they enjoyed the feast of that wicked one
R' Shimon ben Yochai: because they bowed to the idol
R' Shimon ben Yochai: they acted only for appearance, so the Holy One too acted with them only for appearance
and this is as it is written: 'for He does not afflict from His heart' (Lam 3:33)
